svg.aria-label: Input cost of summarizing a 400k-token conversation on Anthropic. Re-reading the history as a new prompt costs 400k tokens at the base price. Re-sending the conversation's own request reads it from the prompt cache at a tenth of that price, about the cost of 40k tokens.
svg.text: INPUT COST OF SUMMARIZING A 400K-TOKEN CONVERSATION
no cache hit, whole history at the base price
Suzent: the conversation's own request, plus one instruction
history read from the prompt cache at 0.1× the base price
Token-equivalents at Anthropic cache pricing. The summary's own output tokens cost the same either way.
